snippet.title: The Walking Trade - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
LAUNCHING 5th March 2026 on Steam.
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3398110/The_Walking_Trade/

Store management sim set in a zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store - and your fate.
